target: bench.sh reconcile — never deletes a bench with uncommitted changes
cmd: source "$FIXTURES/bench-repo.sh"; bench_fixture_setup; cd work; export FACTORY_BENCH_DIR="$PWD/../benches"; mkdir -p .agentic; echo '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; bench_fixture_spec . pr-open feature 001; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; bench_reconcile; echo dirty > "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/uncommitted.txt"; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; tracker_advance factory/specs/001-t.md done; ERR=$(bench_reconcile 2>&1 >/dev/null); jq -n --arg exists "$([ -d "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" ] && echo yes || echo no)" --arg err "$ERR" '{exists: $exists, err: $err}'
